reproduction_steps: Shoot a stationary target at 44 distances at 60/30/20 FPS using old point-only collision
bugs.observation: 5 / 24 / 33 misses respectively; exact viewer weapon wording not independently verified
bugs.impact: Expensive fast weapon may appear to fire without damage
bugs.cause: Only endpoint sampled for collision; laser rendered as a small fast projectile
bugs.fix: Immediate visible laser pulses and swept segment collision for fast projectiles
bugs.retest: 0 / 0 / 0 misses, 130 damage from holding fire for one second. Numerical before evidence in laser-before.json, no pre-fix video.

reproduction_steps: Complete ordinary wave and start free testing before the 1.5s transition callback
bugs.observation: Old callback could clear newly spawned sandbox enemies
bugs.impact: Interrupted free testing and invalidated an early pressure sample
bugs.cause: Delayed callback checked only current battle state
bugs.fix: Generation token invalidates callbacks across new games, loads and restarts; sandbox guard
bugs.retest: Forced victory then new sandbox remained in battle; all 48 stress enemies alive at end of 30s measurement
